description.zh:
资源标签类型，用于查询的过滤条件。取值：

- all（默认值）：全部标签。
- custom：自定义标签。
- system：系统标签。

> 取值不区分大小写。
description.en:
The type of the resource tags. This parameter specifies a filter condition for the query. Valid values:

- all (default value)

- custom

- system

> The value of this parameter is not case-sensitive.

description.zh:
模糊查询类型。取值：

- EQUAL（默认值）：精确查询。
- PREFIX：根据前缀进行模糊查询。
description.en:
The type of the query. Valid values:

- EQUAL (default): exact match

- PREFIX: prefix-based fuzzy match
The token that is used to start the next query.

description.zh:
分页时每页显示的标签键个数。

最大值：1000。默认值：50。
description.en:
The number of tag keys to return on each page.

Maximum value: 1000. Default value: 50.

description.zh:
标签类型，用于查询的过滤条件。取值：

- ResourceTag（默认值）：资源标签。包括自定义标签和系统标签。
- MetaTag：预置标签。

> 取值不区分大小写。
description.en:
The category of the tags. This parameter specifies a filter condition for the query. Valid values:

- ResourceTag: resource tags, including custom and system tags. This is the default value.

- MetaTag: preset tags.

> The value of this parameter is not case-sensitive.

description.zh:
地域ID。

关于地域ID的详情，请参见[服务接入点](~~2330902~~)。
description.en:
The region ID.

For more information about region IDs, see [Endpoints](~~2330902~~).

description.zh:
资源类型，用于查询的过滤条件。

格式：`ALIYUN::${ProductCode}::${ResourceType}`，全部大写。

- `ProductCode`：云服务code。从[ListSupportResourceTypes](~~2330915~~)返回参数中获取。
- `ResourceType`：资源类型。从[ListSupportResourceTypes](~~2330915~~)返回参数中获取。
description.en:
The resource type. This parameter specifies a filter condition for the query.

Format: `ALIYUN::${ProductCode}::${ResourceType}`. All letters in the value of this parameter must be in uppercase.

- `ProductCode`: the service code. You can set this field to a value obtained from the response of the [ListSupportResourceTypes](~~2330915~~) operation.

- `ResourceType`: the resource type. You can set this field to a value obtained from the response of the [ListSupportResourceTypes](~~2330915~~) operation.

description.zh:
模糊查询的标签键。

该参数与`FuzzyType`配合使用。
description.en:
The tag key for a fuzzy query.

This parameter is used together with the `FuzzyType` parameter.

descriptions.en: This topic provides an example on how to call the API operation to query the tag keys in the `cn-hangzhou` region. The response shows that the following tag keys exist: `team`, `k1`, and `k2`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun tag list-tag-keys --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --page-size 50 --category all --resource-type ALIYUN::ECS::INSTANCE --query-type ResourceTag --fuzzy-type EQUAL --tag-filter-key team --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun tag ListTagKeys --region cn-hangzhou --Category all --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --PageSize 50 --ResourceType 'ALIYUN::ECS::INSTANCE' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --FuzzyType EQUAL --TagFilter.Key team --QueryType ResourceTag
